subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Learn and say 12 shopping words and phrases.
Sort shopping words into things and people.

tf.s: A queue is a line of people waiting.
tf.why: Yes, people wait in a queue to pay.

tf.s: A receipt is the machine where you pay.
tf.why: The machine is the till; a receipt is the paper you get after you pay.

tf.s: A customer is a person who buys things in a shop.

tf.why: Second-hand things have been used by someone before.

tf.s: If you get a refund, you get your money back.
tf.why: Right, a refund gives your money back.

tf.s: Rosie doesn't like shopping because she doesn't want to stand in a queue.
tf.why: Yes, Rosie hates waiting in queues.

tf.s: A shop assistant is a thing you see in a shop.
tf.why: A shop assistant is a person who works in a shop.

tf.s: Manar likes buying tablets and laptops in second-hand shops.
tf.why: Well done, that's what Manar says.

tf.s: In 'receipt', we say the letter p.
tf.why: The p in receipt is silent.

tf.s: Ali thinks buying things made in our country helps the environment.
tf.why: Yes, and it helps the people who make them.

boxes.q: What is the paper you get after you pay?
boxes.why: You get a receipt after paying.

boxes.q: What is the machine where you pay in a shop?
Complete: Can I ___ this shirt for a bigger size?
boxes.why: Exchange means change it for another one.

boxes.q: Complete: The jacket was broken, so I got a ___.
boxes.why: A refund gives you your money back.

boxes.q: How does Eric pay at Sports Superstar?
When something is cheaper than usual, it is ...
boxes.why: On sale means at a lower price.

boxes.q: Which is a person in a shop?
boxes.why: A shop assistant is a person.

boxes.q: Buying things on the internet is ...
boxes.why: Online shopping happens on the internet.

boxes.q: Which is the opposite of spend money?

hunt.q: Person who works in a shop
Money back for a broken item

mcq.q: What do you call a line of people waiting to pay?
mcq.why: A queue is a line of people.

mcq.q: Where does Manar like shopping for tablets and laptops?
Which group shows only people in a shop?
mcq.why: Customers and shop assistants are people.

mcq.q: Which word has a silent p?
mcq.why: We don't say the p in receipt.

mcq.q: Your new shoes are too small. What do you ask?
o: Can I exchange these for a bigger size?
mcq.why: Exchange means swap for another one.

mcq.q: You don't want to use cash. How can you pay?
mcq.why: Contactless lets you pay with a card without cash.

o: I'm better at saving money than spending it.
I till my money every week.
I receipt money at the shop.
mcq.why: Save and spend are money verbs.

mcq.q: Why doesn't Rosie like going shopping?
o: She doesn't want to stand in a queue.
mcq.why: Rosie hates waiting in queues, so her parents buy online.

mcq.q: Why does Ali think we should buy things made in our country?
o: It helps the environment and the people who make them.
mcq.why: Local products help the environment and local workers.

mcq.q: Which item belongs with 'things you see in a shop'?
mcq.why: A bank card is a thing; the others are people.
